args.prompt: Doors open; color returns. Dawn at a bus stop: a city bus pulls in, doors hissing open; warm color starts seeping back into the ink-wash world from the sunrise. Camera: Wide, bus entering frame. 1990s cel anime; color and monochrome ink wash bleeding into each other. Keep the art style, characters, faces, hair, outfits and any lettering exactly as in the first frame. Characters do not speak or sing; mouths stay closed or relaxed. No new text or subtitles.
args.negative_prompt: 3D render, CGI, photorealistic, morphing, warped faces, extra limbs, extra people, subtitles, captions, watermark, text changes
